findings.evidence: Lines 80-84 expose only the pointwise `quotientCoact_mk`; lines 86-91 contain the map-level characteristic equation but mark it `private`.
findings.fix: Make `quotientCoact_comp_mkQ` public, with a normal-form statement for `N.quotientCoact.comp N.toSubmodule.mkQ`; add `@[simp]` only if it rewrites in the intended direction without loops.
findings.issue: The defining map-level equation for `quotientCoact` is proved as `private theorem quotientCoact_comp_mkQ`, so downstream users cannot use the promised characterization of the descended coaction without reproving it.

findings.evidence: Line 197 has `@[expose] def mkQ`; lines 203-210 provide `@[simp]` lemmas `mkQ_toLinearMap` and `mkQ_apply`.
findings.fix: Remove `@[expose]` from `mkQ` and keep downstream use through `mkQ_toLinearMap`, `mkQ_apply`, and `Comodule.Hom.map_coact_apply`.
findings.issue: `mkQ` is marked `@[expose]` even though its public `toLinearMap` and application lemmas already characterize the bundled morphism, exposing the body unnecessarily.

findings.evidence: Lines 222-227 define `liftQ` with underlying map `N.toSubmodule.liftQ f.toLinearMap hf`; `rg` finds `mkQ_toLinearMap` and product analogues such as `prodLift_toLinearMap`, but no `liftQ_toLinearMap`.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp] theorem liftQ_toLinearMap ... : (N.liftQ f hf).toLinearMap = N.toSubmodule.liftQ f.toLinearMap hf := rfl` with the same local `AddCommGroup P` instance used by `liftQ_apply`.
findings.issue: `liftQ` lacks the standard underlying-linear-map characterization, unlike the other bundled morphism APIs in this area, so users cannot rewrite `(N.liftQ f hf).toLinearMap` to `N.toSubmodule.liftQ f.toLinearMap hf` directly.

summary: The quotient construction exposes the right objects, but the characteristic API is incomplete and one bundled morphism body is unnecessarily exposed.
